text:
vivian.partners: Need a short contingency plan for Gaudi/MI300 onramp. Two risks: vendor microcode slip and regional MI300 capacity dip. Can we capture a single fallback mapping and owners?

pavel-hw: I'll take HW validation artifacts (firmware.sig, kernel-tag, bench-thermal.csv). Note: Habana flagged a possible microcode RC that could land late-July.

sara-prod: Marketplace needs: tile JSON, human fallback blurb, embargo window. Legal wants exact dates before we publish. Also request: a customer-facing sentence about expected perf delta when falling back.

leo-devex: Devex will produce quickstart + SI installer + minimal CI smoke. Example smoke command to include:
```
./smoke_check --model "llama2-13b" --seq 1024 --bs 1 --p50 140
```
I'll add a small `canary/` folder for SI.

anya-oncall: Ops: propose routing pseudo-rule: `if mi300_region_cap < 0.15 -> route_to [h200,b200,gaudi_compat]` and a 10-minute auto-fallback grace window. Need SRE signoff and explicit SLO drop notes for canary customers.

vivian.partners: Owners: Pavel->HW; Sara->marketplace+embargo; Leo->devex+CI; Anya->ops playbook; Vivian->press + handoff doc. Draft mapping by Tue EOD, cert artifacts by Fri.

pavel-hw: I'll DM vendor contacts after this thread (nvidia:maria@nvidia, habana:raj@habana, amd:lucas@amd) and post freeze dates. If microcode slips, expect +72h on certs.

sara-prod: Marketplace tile draft (snippet):
```json
{"sku":"rw-gaudi-48g","fallback":"If MI300 capacity is constrained, workload may route to H200/B200 variants. Expect ~10-30% latency increase."}
```
I'll attach embargo dates in the sheet.

leo-devex: CI bot: creating job `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke` and a canary harness. Will PR quickstart by Wed.

ci-bot: CI job created: `ci/marketplace/gaudi-mi300/smoke` (status: queued)

anya-oncall: Filed INFRA-6001 for `lab-image: power-profile-gaudi-v1` to repro thermal. Also adding playbook bullet: escalate to SRE if fallback >30m.

vivian.partners: Recap action items posted in sheet "Gaudi-MI300 Onramp". Adding a short customer blurb for marketplace and SI handoff checklist. Putting a 20-min sync Tue 09:30 to confirm vendor freeze and embargo. Please flag blockers here. :calendar:
